responses.value: Grow mainly through franchising. Our $9M covers only 10 of our own restaurants in 3 years, while franchisees have offered to open 40, each paying about $90,000 a year in royalties at almost no capital cost. The main risk is quality: franchised chains in the region score 10% lower. The next step is to sign 10 franchisees first, with strict quality audits, before opening the rest.
$9M opens only 10 of our own restaurants, while 40 franchises bring about $3.6M a year. Hold: franchise most.
